#| standalone: true

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(shinylive)
library(shinythemes)

beta_normal <- function(m = 2, n = 2) {
  vals <- dbeta(seq(0, 1, by = 0.01), m, n)
  plot(seq(0, 1, by = 0.01), vals, type = "l", xlim = c(0, 1), 
       xlab = expression(bold(X[ij])), 
       ylab = expression(bold(f(X[ij]))), 
       main = bquote(bold("Probability Density Function for B(" * .(round(m, 2)) * ", " * .(round(n, 2)) * ")")))
}

BIRM <- function(theta, delta, tau, equation = FALSE) {
  middle <- theta - delta
  enumerator_m <- middle + tau
  enumerator_n <- -middle + tau
  m <- exp(enumerator_m / 2)
  n <- exp(enumerator_n / 2)
  if (equation == TRUE) return(round(c(m, n), 2))
  beta_normal(m, n)
}

BIRM_ERS <- function(theta, delta, tau, ers, equation = FALSE) {
  middle <- theta - delta
  ers_exp <- exp(ers)
  enumerator_m <- ers_exp * middle + tau
  enumerator_n <- -ers_exp * middle + tau
  m <- exp(enumerator_m / 2)
  n <- exp(enumerator_n / 2)
  if (equation == TRUE) return(round(c(m, n), 2))
  beta_normal(m, n)
}

BIRM_ARS <- function(theta, delta, tau, ars, x = 1, equation = FALSE) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  middle <- theta - delta + x * ars
  enumerator_m <- middle + tau
  enumerator_n <- -middle + tau
  m <- exp(enumerator_m / 2)
  n <- exp(enumerator_n / 2)
  if (equation == TRUE) return(round(c(m, n), 2))
  beta_normal(m, n)
}

BIRM_RS <- function(theta, delta, tau, ers, ars, x = 1, equation = FALSE) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  middle <- theta - delta + x * ars
  ers_exp <- exp(ers)
  enumerator_m <- ers_exp * middle + tau
  enumerator_n <- -ers_exp * middle + tau
  m <- exp(enumerator_m / 2)
  n <- exp(enumerator_n / 2)
  if (equation == TRUE) return(round(c(m, n), 2))
  beta_normal(m, n)
}

beta_sample <- function(n = 1000, delta = 0, theta_mu = 0, theta_sd = 1, tau = 2, ars_mu = 0, ars_sd = 0.5, x = 1, ers_mu = 0, ers_sd = 0.5) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  theta_vals <- rnorm(n, theta_mu, theta_sd)
  ars_vals <- rnorm(n, ars_mu, ars_sd)
  ers_vals <- rnorm(n, ers_mu, ers_sd)

  vec <- NULL

  for (i in 1:n) {
    tmp <- BIRM_RS(theta = theta_vals[i], delta = delta, tau = tau, ers = ers_vals[i], ars = ars_vals[i], x = x, equation = TRUE)
    vec <- c(vec, rbeta(1, tmp[1], tmp[2]))
  }
  
  par(mar=c(5.1,4.5,4.1,2.1))

  plot(density(vec), main = paste0("Density From Simulated Data (n = ", n, ")"), xlab = expression(bold(X[ij])), ylab = expression(bold(hat(f)(X[ij]))))
}

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$beta_normal <- renderPlot({
    beta_normal(m = input$m_beta, n = input$n_beta)
  })
  
  output$BIRM <- renderPlot({
    BIRM(theta = input$theta_birm, delta = input$delta_birm, tau = input$tau_birm)
  })
  
  output$BIRM_equation_title <- renderUI({
    tags$div(
      style = "font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; font-family: sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$b("Equations for the Probability Density Function")
    )
  })
  
  output$BIRM_equation <- renderUI({
    withMathJax(
      paste0(
        "$$m_{ij} = exp(\\frac{\\theta_i - \\delta_j + \\tau_j}{2}) = exp(\\frac{", input$theta_birm, " - ", input$delta_birm, " + ", input$tau_birm, "}{2}) = ", 
        BIRM(theta = input$theta_birm, delta = input$delta_birm, tau = input$tau_birm, equation = TRUE)[1], ",$$\n",
        "$$n_{ij} = exp(\\frac{-(\\theta_i - \\delta_j) + \\tau_j}{2}) = exp(\\frac{-(", input$theta_birm, " - ", input$delta_birm, ") + ", input$tau_birm, "}{2}) = ",
        BIRM(theta = input$theta_birm, delta = input$delta_birm, tau = input$tau_birm, equation = TRUE)[2], "$$\n"
      )
    )
  })

  output$BIRM_RS_equation_title <- renderUI({
    tags$div(
      style = "font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; font-family: sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$b("Equations for the Probability Density Function")
    )
  })
  
  output$BIRM_RS <- renderPlot({
    BIRM_RS(theta = input$theta_birm_rs, delta = input$delta_birm_rs, tau = input$tau_birm_rs, 
            ars = input$ars_birm_rs, x = input$x_birm_rs, ers = input$ers_birm_rs)
  })
  
  output$BIRM_RS_equation <- renderUI({
    withMathJax(
      paste0(
        "$$m_{ij} = exp(\\frac{exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - \\delta_j + x_j \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ", 
        "exp(\\frac{exp(", input$ers_birm_rs, ") \\cdot (", input$theta_birm_rs, " - ", input$delta_birm_rs, " + ", input$x_birm_rs, " \\cdot ", input$ars_birm_rs, ") + ", input$tau_birm_rs, "}{2}) = ",
        BIRM_RS(theta = input$theta_birm_rs, delta = input$delta_birm_rs, tau = input$tau_birm_rs, 
                ars = input$ars_birm_rs, x = input$x_birm_rs, ers = input$ers_birm_rs, equation = TRUE)[1], ",$$\n",
        "$$n_{ij} = exp(\\frac{-exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - \\delta_j + x_j \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ",
        "exp(\\frac{-exp(", input$ers_birm_rs, ") \\cdot (", input$theta_birm_rs, " - ", input$delta_birm_rs, " + ", input$x_birm_rs, " \\cdot ", input$ars_birm_rs, ") + ", input$tau_birm_rs, "}{2}) = ",
        BIRM_RS(theta = input$theta_birm_rs, delta = input$delta_birm_rs, tau = input$tau_birm_rs, 
                ars = input$ars_birm_rs, x = input$x_birm_rs, ers = input$ers_birm_rs, equation = TRUE)[2], "$$\n"
      )
    )
  })
  
  output$ERS <- renderPlot({
    BIRM_ERS(theta = input$theta_ers, delta = input$delta_ers, tau = input$tau_ers, ers = input$ers_ers)
  })
  
  output$ERS_equation_title <- renderUI({
    tags$div(
      style = "font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; font-family: sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$b("Equations for the Probability Density Function")
    )
  })
  
  output$ERS_equation <- renderUI({
    withMathJax(
      paste0(
        "$$m_{ij} = exp(\\frac{exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - \\delta_j) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ", 
        "exp(\\frac{exp(", input$ers_ers, ") \\cdot (", input$theta_ers, " - ", input$delta_ers, ") + ", input$tau_ers, "}{2}) = ",
        BIRM_ERS(theta = input$theta_ers, delta = input$delta_ers, tau = input$tau_ers, ers = input$ers_ers, equation = TRUE)[1], ",$$\n",
        "$$n_{ij} = exp(\\frac{-exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - \\delta_j) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ",
        "exp(\\frac{-exp(", input$ers_ers, ") \\cdot (", input$theta_ers, " - ", input$delta_ers, ") + ", input$tau_ers, "}{2}) = ",
        BIRM_ERS(theta = input$theta_ers, delta = input$delta_ers, tau = input$tau_ers, ers = input$ers_ers, equation = TRUE)[2], "$$\n"
      )
    )
  })
  
  output$ARS <- renderPlot({
    BIRM_ARS(theta = input$theta_ars, delta = input$delta_ars, tau = input$tau_ars, ars = input$ars_ars, x = input$x_ars)
  })
  
  output$ARS_equation_title <- renderUI({
    tags$div(
      style = "font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; font-family: sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$b("Equations for the Probability Density Function")
    )
  })
  
  output$ARS_equation <- renderUI({
    withMathJax(
      paste0(
        "$$m_{ij} = exp(\\frac{(\\theta_i - \\delta_j + x_j \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ", 
        "exp(\\frac{(", input$theta_ars, " - ", input$delta_ars, " + ", input$x_ars, " \\cdot ", input$ars_ars, ") + ", input$tau_ars, "}{2}) = ",
        BIRM_ARS(theta = input$theta_ars, delta = input$delta_ars, tau = input$tau_ars, ars = input$ars_ars, x = input$x_ars, equation = TRUE)[1], ",$$\n",
        "$$n_{ij} = exp(\\frac{-(\\theta_i - \\delta_j + x_j \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ",
        "exp(\\frac{-(", input$theta_ars, " - ", input$delta_ars, " + ", input$x_ars, " \\cdot ", input$ars_ars, ") + ", input$tau_ars, "}{2}) = ",
        BIRM_ARS(theta = input$theta_ars, delta = input$delta_ars, tau = input$tau_ars, ars = input$ars_ars, x = input$x_ars, equation = TRUE)[2], "$$\n"
      )
    )
  })

  output$simulation_equation_title <- renderUI({
    tags$div(
      style = "font-weight: bold; font-size: 14px; font-family: sans-serif; text-align: center;",
      tags$b("Equations for Data Simulation")
    )
  })

  output$simulation_equation <- renderUI({
    withMathJax(
      paste0(
        "$$m_{ij} = exp(\\frac{exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - \\delta_j + x_j \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ", 
        "exp(\\frac{exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - ", input$delta_sim, " + ", input$x_sim, " \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + ", input$tau_sim, "}{2}),$$\n",
        "$$n_{ij} = exp(\\frac{-exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - \\delta_j + x_j \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + \\tau_j}{2}) = ", 
        "exp(\\frac{-exp(\\eta^{ERS}_i) \\cdot (\\theta_i - ", input$delta_sim, " + ", input$x_sim, " \\cdot \\eta^{ARS}_i) + ", input$tau_sim, "}{2}),$$\n",
        "$$\\theta_i \\sim \\mathcal{N}(", input$theta_mu_sim, ", ", input$theta_sd_sim, "),$$\n",
        "$$\\eta^{ERS}_i \\sim \\mathcal{N}(", input$ers_mu_sim, ", ", input$ers_sd_sim, "),$$\n",
        "$$\\eta^{ARS}_i \\sim \\mathcal{N}(", input$ars_mu_sim, ", ", input$ars_sd_sim, ")$$\n"
      )
    )
  })

  output$simulation <- renderPlot({

    beta_sample(n = 1000, delta = input$delta_sim, theta_mu = input$theta_mu_sim, theta_sd = input$theta_sd_sim, 
                tau = input$tau_sim, ars_mu = input$ars_mu_sim, ars_sd = input$ars_sd_sim, 
                x = input$x_sim, ers_mu = input$ers_mu_sim, ers_sd = input$ers_sd_sim)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
